title: Construction Change Order Workflow: From Field Request to Signed Scope and Updated Budget
author: WNY Business Automation
metaDescription: A practical construction change order workflow for Buffalo and Western New York contractors, from field request and pricing through approval and budget update.
excerpt: A practical change-order workflow for remodelers and project-based contractors, covering field requests, scope, cost, schedule, customer approval, procurement, budget updates, stop rules, and human review.
